scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @werewolf/server" "npm run dev -w @werewolf/web"
scripts.build:secret-hitler: npm --prefix secret_hitler run build && mkdir -p apps/web/dist/secret_hitler && cp -R secret_hitler/apps/client/dist/. apps/web/dist/secret_hitler/
scripts.build:render: npm run build && npm run build:deception && npm run build:secret-hitler && npm run build:gomoku && npm run build:hushfall
scripts.build: npm run build -w @werewolf/shared && npm run build -w @werewolf/server && npm run build -w @werewolf/web && npm --prefix avalon run build && npm --prefix skullking run build && npm --prefix spacecrew run build && npm --prefix rummikub run build && npm run build:selector
scripts.build:selector: mkdir -p apps/web/dist && cp game-selector/index.html apps/web/dist/index.html && cp game-selector/launcher.css apps/web/dist/launcher.css
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @werewolf/shared && npm run typecheck -w @werewolf/server && npm run typecheck -w @werewolf/web
scripts.build:hushfall: npm --prefix hushfall run build && mkdir -p apps/web/dist/hushfall && cp -R hushfall/dist/. apps/web/dist/hushfall/
scripts.build:gomoku: npm --prefix gomoku run build && mkdir -p apps/web/dist/gomoku && cp -R gomoku/dist/. apps/web/dist/gomoku/
